title: Tichurong language
text: Tichurong, also known as Poike, Poinke, Rongke, or Tichurongke, is an unwritten Tibeto-Burman language of the Sino-Tibetan family spoken by approximately 2,700 people across eighteen villages in the remote Tichurong Valley of Dolpa District in northwestern Nepal.
